questions.exp: A pilot operates an aircraft. A captain operates a ship. Same worker-vehicle relationship.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If 'PAPER' is coded as 'QBQFS', how is 'PENCIL' coded in the same pattern?
questions.exp: Each letter shifted +1: P+1=Q,E+1=F,N+1=O,C+1=D,I+1=J,L+1=M = QFODJM.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A walks 4km North, 3km West, 4km South. Find the distance from the starting point.
questions.exp: 4km North and 4km South cancel each other. Only 3km West remains. Distance=3km.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: 21, 33, 39, 51, 65
questions.exp: 21,33,39,51 are all divisible by 3 (21=3×7, 33=3×11, 39=3×13, 51=3×17). 65 is not divisible by 3 — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 45 students, Aarav is 19th from the right. What is his position from the left?
questions.exp: Position from left = Total+1-Position from right = 46-19 = 27th.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: All pens are pencils. Some pencils are erasers. Which conclusion follows?
questions.exp: All pens are pencils, but only SOME pencils are erasers — we cannot determine if those specific pencils overlap with pens. No definite conclusion connecting pens and erasers follows.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A and B can complete a work in 18 days. B alone can do it in 30 days. In how many days can A alone complete it?
questions.exp: Combined rate=1/18. B's rate=1/30. A's rate=1/18-1/30=5/90-3/90=2/90=1/45. A alone takes 45 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: Two trains 140m and 160m long run in the same direction at 72 km/h and 54 km/h. Find the time taken to cross each other.
questions.exp: Relative speed=72-54=18 km/h=5 m/s. Total distance=140+160=300m. Time=300/5=60 seconds.

questions.subject: English

questions.exp: 'Insist on' is the correct preposition usage, followed by a gerund: 'insisted on paying'.

opts: Something good that initially seemed bad
questions.exp: 'A blessing in disguise' refers to something that seems unfortunate at first but turns out to be beneficial.

questions.subject: English
questions.q: Find the error: 'Each of the players have received their certificates.'
questions.exp: 'Each' is singular, so the verb should be 'has received', not 'have received'.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which Mughal ruler is credited with abolishing the Jizya tax?
questions.exp: Akbar abolished the Jizya tax (a tax on non-Muslims) as part of his policy of religious tolerance.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: The 'Sangam' period in South Indian history is associated primarily with which region?
questions.exp: The Sangam period refers to the ancient era of Tamil history and literature, roughly from 300 BCE to 300 CE.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth's atmosphere?
questions.exp: Nitrogen makes up approximately 78% of Earth's atmosphere, the most abundant gas.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: The 'Rajya Sabha' has a maximum strength of how many members?
questions.exp: The Rajya Sabha has a maximum strength of 250 members — 238 elected and 12 nominated by the President.

questions.subject: GK
questions.q: Which Indian state has the largest number of UNESCO World Heritage Sites?
questions.exp: Maharashtra has the largest number of UNESCO World Heritage Sites among Indian states, including Ajanta and Ellora Caves.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: If North-East becomes South, then South-West becomes:
questions.exp: Each direction is rotated 135° clockwise (NE moves to S). Applying the same 135° clockwise rotation to South-West gives North-East.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Apple, Mango, Potato, Banana
questions.exp: Apple, Mango, and Banana are fruits. Potato is a vegetable — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: P is the daughter of Q. R is the son of P. S is the brother of R. How is Q related to S?
questions.exp: P is Q's daughter. R is P's son, so R is Q's grandchild. S is R's brother, so S is also Q's grandchild. Q is S's grandparent.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a row of 28 people, A is 11th from the left and B is 9th from the right. How many people are between A and B?
questions.exp: B's position from left=28-9+1=20. People between A(11th) and B(20th)=20-11-1=8.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find next term: 3, 6, 11, 18, 27, ?
questions.exp: Differences: 3,5,7,9 → next difference=11. 27+11=38.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A can complete a job in 24 days. B is 50% more efficient than A. In how many days can B alone complete the job?
questions.exp: B's efficiency = 1.5 × A's efficiency. B's time = A's time ÷ 1.5 = 24/1.5 = 16 days.

questions.subject: Maths
questions.q: A boat covers 24km upstream in 6 hours and the same distance downstream in 4 hours. Find the speed of the stream.
questions.exp: Upstream speed=24/6=4 km/h. Downstream speed=24/4=6 km/h. Stream speed=(6-4)/2=1 km/h.

questions.exp: 'Hit the nail on the head' means to describe or identify something accurately.

questions.exp: Mercury is the smallest planet in our solar system (Pluto is no longer classified as a planet).

questions.exp: The Rowlatt Act of 1919 was popularly known as the 'Black Act', allowing detention without trial.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: A person facing South turns 45° clockwise, then 90° clockwise again. Which direction does he face now?
questions.exp: Facing South, turn 45° clockwise=South-West, then turn 90° clockwise more=North-West.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the odd one: Hexagon, Pentagon, Square, Sphere
questions.exp: Hexagon, Pentagon, and Square are 2D shapes (polygons). Sphere is a 3D shape — the odd one.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: X is the brother of Y. Y is the daughter of Z. Z is the husband of W. How is X related to W?
questions.exp: Z is W's husband. Y is Z's daughter, making Y also W's daughter. X is Y's brother, so X is also W's son.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: In a class of 50, Riya ranks 23rd from the top. What is her rank from the bottom?
questions.exp: Rank from bottom = Total+1-Rank from top = 51-23 = 28th.

questions.subject: Reasoning
questions.q: Find the missing term: B3, E6, H9, K12, ?
questions.exp: Letters skip 2 (B,E,H,K,N) and numbers increase by 3 (3,6,9,12,15). Answer=N15.
